title_en: Why was this path chosen? — BGP Local Preference
title_ja: なぜこの経路が選ばれた？— BGP Local Preference
problem_en: r1 hears 8.8.8.0/24 from both r2 and r3. r1 de-prefers r2 with LocalPref 50, so r3 (default 100) wins. Open r1 and read the Best-Path Decision in the DeepDive to see why.
problem_ja: 8.8.8.0/24 を r2・r3 双方から受信。r1 が r2 を LocalPref 50 に下げ、r3（既定100）が勝つ。r1 を開き DeepDive の Best-Path Decision で理由を見る。
